* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it
* Nutritious, wholesome **meals provided daily**


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

* **2nd, 4th \& 5th weeks of the month:** Monday to Saturday.

title: Designation- Trainee Database & Backend developerLocation: Kolkata/ Noida
description:
### **Experience: FreshersQualification: B. E / B.Tech / MCA / BCA/ B.Sc (CS/IT) / Diploma in IT or related field Work Mode: Work from Office (Kolkata/Noida) Employment Type: Full\-Time Salary\- 22 k**

**Number of Vacancies: 2 Positions**


### **Eligibility Criteria:**


**Experience:** 0 to 1 year of experience (Freshers with strong academic/personal project portfolios in SQL, Oracle, PL/SQL, or PostgreSQL are highly encouraged to apply).


**Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science (CS) or Information Technology (IT) / MCA / M.Sc (CS).


**Work Type:** Full\-time.


**Job Location:** Noida or Kolkata

### **Job Summary:**


We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented **Database \& Backend Developer (Fresher)** with a strong foundation in **SQL and Stored Procedures (Oracle or PostgreSQL)**. In this role, your primary focus will be designing, optimizing, and maintaining backend database logic to ensure seamless data validation, log tracking, and workflow management.


While the core focus is database engineering, familiarity or academic exposure to **C/C\+\+** is highly preferred, as you will work closely with our core system\-level engineering modules. This is an excellent opportunity for a fresher to gain hands\-on experience in building enterprise\-level relational database structures and low\-latency backend architectures.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


**Database Logic \& Development:** Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, **Stored Procedures**, triggers, packages, and custom functions in **Oracle and/or PostgreSQL**.


**Data Validation \& Integrity:** Design database schemas and constraints to ensure high data integrity, accurate log tracking, and smooth enterprise integrations.


**Performance Tuning:** Identify database bottlenecks, analyze execution plans, optimize slow\-running queries, and implement indexing strategies to minimize latency.


**Backend Integration:** Collaborate with core backend engineers to integrate relational database logic with system\-level modules and multi\-language SDKs.


**Debugging \& Maintenance:** Analyze database logs, error reports, and application behaviors to diagnose and resolve data\-flow anomalies.


**Documentation:** Create and maintain documentation for database designs, schema architecture, and pseudocode logic for complex procedures.


### **Required Skills and Qualifications:**


#### **1\. Core Technical Skills (Primary Focus):**


**Databases:** Solid understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), specifically **Oracle** or **PostgreSQL**.


**Database Programming:** Deep, hands\-on knowledge of writing and troubleshooting **Stored Procedures**, triggers, functions, and relational queries.


**Data Foundations:** Strong understanding of relational data modeling, normalization, indexing, and transactional concepts (ACID properties).


**Problem Solving:** Excellent logical thinking and ability to draft pseudocode to plan out complex data manipulation logic.


#### **2\. Preferred Add\-on Skills (Highly Desirable):**


**Languages:** Foundational knowledge or academic exposure to **C and C\+\+** (specifically understanding how application code interacts with databases).


**Object\-Oriented Concepts:** Understanding of basic OOPs principles to align with backend infrastructure.


**Data Formats:** Familiarity with handling and parsing structured data formats like **XML** and **JSON** within the database.


Exposure to basic server environments (Windows/Linux) and basic software development life cycles (SDLC).


#### **3\. Soft Skills \& Analytical Abilities:**


Sharp analytical mindset with a focus on data accuracy and validation.


Strong verbal and written communication skills to document workflows clearly.


A proactive approach to learning new database technologies and optimization tools.

title: Instrumentation Sales Engineer
description:
**Title: Instrumentation Sales for Sensors and Applications.** 

**Location: Mumbai.** 

Our customers span automotive, packaging, food and beverage, chemicals, pharma, compressed air, water and utilities, and Industry 4\.0 digitalisation.

**THE ROLE**

A consultative, field\-heavy position.

You walk factory floors across Mumbai, Pune, and Nashik, read the machines, run discovery conversations with maintenance and plant teams, map sensor and IIoT opportunities, and convert technical conversations into quotations and orders.

You sell outcomes (reduced downtime, lower energy cost, real\-time visibility), not part numbers.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Conduct 3–4 plant visits per week across the Mumbai–Pune–Nashik industrial belt; perform walk\-throughs to identify sensor, IO\-Link, and IIoT opportunities on machines and lines.
* Run structured discovery with maintenance, production, plant management, projects, and IT/OT stakeholders, asking questions like “Which machine causes the most unplanned stoppages?” and “How do you track motor health today?”
* Demonstrate **sensors** and **products**, on\-site; execute proof\-of\-concept deployments on one machine to prove ROI before expanding. Prepare and follow up on quotations daily;
* Manage CRM pipeline with visit notes, contact data, and conversion tracking. Plan visits by geography ; rotate product categories to ensure full portfolio coverage.
* Gather market intelligence on competitor activity, customer pain points, and new project pipelines; photograph and document applications.

**TECHNICAL SCOPE**

You will be trained across all of the following.

Prior familiarity accelerates your ramp.

Position sensors (inductive, photoelectric, capacitive, ultrasonic), process sensors (pressure, flow, level, temperature, conductivity), condition monitoring (vibration, oil quality, octavis), IO\-Link masters and gateways, IIoT platform, safety technology, and connection technology.

**Industries**: factory automation (automotive, FMCG, packaging, OEMs), process and utilities (F\&B, chemicals, pharma, compressed air, water), mobile machines, and Industry 4\.0 digitalisation.

**Technical foundations:** measurement principles, signal types (PNP/NPN, 4–20 mA), PLC and fieldbus basics, process variables and units, P\&ID reading, hazardous\-area classification, IP ratings, sensor failure modes, and calibration.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 

**Must Have** B.E./B.Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

0–2 years in industrial sales, application engineering, or field service involving sensors, instrumentation, or automation. Fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude and genuine interest in factory\-floor work will be considered.

**Willingness to travel 3–4 days per week across Mumbai and surrounding areas, sometimes Nashik.**

Fluent in English, Hindi, and Marathi.

Commercial discipline: quotation preparation, follow\-up cadence, CRM hygiene, pipeline tracking.

title: Production Technician
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

*Candidates will be selected to support either the Composites or Assembly track. Candidates will have the option to choose their preference while filling out the application form.*

**Common across both tracks:**
------------------------------

* **Precision Work** — Do detailed, careful work where alignment and finish matter. Millimetre\-level accuracy, clean cable layout, correct tightness, no shortcuts
* **Quality Focus** — Check your own work at every step, point out problems early, follow checklists carefully, and keep proper build records
* **Spotting Defects** — Inspect parts for issues relevant to your track — misalignment, loose fasteners, bad crimps (Assembly) or air pockets, layer separation, dry spots, and resin\-starved areas (Composites); raise issues early and help find the root cause
* **Tools \& Workstation Care** — Keep your bench, jigs, fixtures, moulds, and tools clean and ready; leave the line tidy so the next shift can start without trouble
* **Proto Support (for top performers)** — Work directly with engineers on first builds, fix fitment issues and share what you learn back to production
* **Continuous Improvement** — Suggest fixes when something is slow, error\-prone, or unsafe; small daily improvements add up

**Assembly Track:**
-------------------

* **Drone Assembly** — Build sub\-assemblies and full aircraft following SOPs \- fitting the airframe, mounting motors and ESCs, routing harnesses, placing sensors, and tightening fasteners to the right spec
* **Electrical \& Mechanical Work** — Crimping, soldering, building wire harnesses, and using torque tools across the aircraft
* **Adhesive Dispensing \& Surface Prep** — Comfort with using adhesive guns and doing surface prep like sanding is a strong plus

**Composites Track:**
---------------------

* **Composites Work** — Cut, place, and lay up carbon fibre and fibreglass layers into moulds as per the layup plan; work with resin systems, wet layup, and prepreg
* **Vacuum Bagging \& Curing** — Set up bagging materials, breather layers, and vacuum lines; remove air pockets and hold a full vacuum without leaks; run oven and autoclave cycles from start to finish

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**

* Excellent hand skills and a steady hand — able to work with small parts, fine wires, tight tolerances, or delicate layups without losing patience
* Comfort reading basic engineering drawings, parts lists, layup plans, and assembly instructions
* Ability to follow SOPs carefully while also speaking up when something doesn't look right
* Willingness to commute to or relocate near Hoskote
* For experienced candidates: Real hands\-on experience in assembly, fabrication, or composites — through past work or vocational training

**Good to Have**

* For freshers: Hands\-on experience through personal projects, vocational training, or internships
* ITI / Diploma in Fitter, Electronics Mechanic, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), or similar trade
* Past experience in drone, aerospace, EV, robotics, wind energy, marine FRP, or precision instrument manufacturing
* Familiarity with crimping, soldering, harness building, torque tools, adhesive dispensing, and sanding (Assembly Track) or prepreg carbon fibre, vacuum infusion, and autoclave work (Composites Track)
* Exposure to lean manufacturing, 5S, or production line ways of working

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Cares about getting the job done thoroughly
* Have an eye detail work and doesn't cut corners
* Comfortable asking questions when unsure
* Can focus through long, repetitive tasks
* Wants to work on drones that actually fly

**Compensation range:** **2 \- 3\.5 LPA (freshers), 3\.5 \- ₹4\.5 LPA (experienced candidates)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*This is our estimated budget for this skillset and current market. Candidates expecting a higher CTC are encouraged to apply and share their expected CTC in the application form along with the skills and experience that justify it. Where a candidate lands within the salary range will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, skills, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, location, shift, and what the team needs.*

**Work Location:** **Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)**
--------------------------------------------------------

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it
* Nutritious, wholesome **meals provided daily**


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* **1st \& 3rd weeks of the month:** Monday to Friday.
* **2nd, 4th \& 5th weeks of the month:** Monday to Saturday.

**Ready to take off?**

As a **Customer Support Specialist,** you will work directly with employers hiring on Apna and support them across **calls, emails, and chats**. This role is perfect for candidates who enjoy **problem\-solving, communication, relationship\-building, and creating great customer experiences.**


The ideal candidate should have good communication skills in **English and Hindi**, a **customer\-first mindset**, a positive attitude, and a strong willingness to learn **CRM tools, support processes, digital platforms, and professional customer success practices.**

Blended – Call Heavy/Open to chat and email

Churn Management, Reactivation of customer, Job posting queries.

 **Requirements** **Key Responsibilities:**

**Must\-Haves:**

* We are looking for enthusiastic freshers who are ready to take their first step into a professional customer support career.

* You should have a laptop, stable Wi\-Fi connection of at least **30 Mbps,** and a dedicated work\-from\-home setup.

* You should be flexible to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and extended hours when required.

**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, implement, and maintain Linux\-based server infrastructures with a focus on reliability and scalability.
   

  

 Perform comprehensive system monitoring, diagnostics, and performance optimization
   

  

 Configure and manage network hardware, including switches, routers, and complex cabling systems
   

  

 Develop and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless technological integration.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
***OUR MISSION***




**At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights\-out automation for their mission\-critical business processes.** 




  





***ABOUT US***




 Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission\-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS\-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.
 



  





***CORE VALUES***




 One Team. One Redwood
 



 Make Your Own Weather
 



 Obsess over Customer Success
 



 Work the Problem
 



 Be Curious
 



 Own the Outcome
 



 Respect Each Other
 








***YOUR IMPACT***




 The Professional Service Consultant role is instrumental in assisting Redwood customers ranging from Fortune global enterprises to midsized businesses to leverage our solutions to orchestrate automation across distributed and heterogeneous platforms and enterprise business applications including SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, data warehousing and OS tasks.
 



  





 The range of responsibilities includes product installation and configuration, training, conducting workshops and providing best practices guidance to advance our customer’s automation business needs.
 


* Assist customers with installation, configuration, training and use of Redwood solutions
* Perform analysis, scoping, and effort estimation to meet customer requirements
* Provide configuration, architecture \& installation recommendations based on product best practices \& customer needs

* Utilize supporting materials (project plan templates, architecture diagrams, etc) to communicate findings \& recommendations to the customer or internally
* Travel to customers, partners, and Redwood Software sites as needed








***YOUR EXPERIENCE***



* 3\+ years of IT Consulting experience
* Proven competence in IT Consulting, including training, installation, architecture design, and testing
* Interest in problem\-solving \& learning new technologies
* Experience or an understanding of SaaS solutions \& integrations
* Knowledge of one or more Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)

* Experience with UNIX, Windows, \& Linux at a power user level
* Experience and understanding of API usage, including REST and SOAP
* Knowledge of communication protocols, including HTTP, FTP, and SSH
* Good communication \& presentation skills
* Excellent time management and task management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple client projects
* Demonstrated ability to learn on the go/on the job in a fast\-paced environment

title: Software Engineer, Salesforce
description:
LinkedIn is the world’s largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We’re also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that’s built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As a Salesforce Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high‑quality solutions on the Salesforce platform. You will work across frontend and backend development using Salesforce technologies, collaborate with cross‑functional partners, translate business needs into technical designs, and contribute to modern, AI‑powered customer experiences. Strong expertise in Salesforce fundamentals, LWC, Agentforce, Salesforce Data Cloud, and Generative‑AI–driven solutions is essential for success in this role.
   

  

  

  

 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  

  

  

 Responsibilities
   

  




* Design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce applications using
 **Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.**
* Build responsive, accessible user interfaces aligned with
 **Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).**
* Develop backend logic, integrations, and APIs using
 **Apex, REST/SOAP services, and platform events.**
* Collaborate with Product Managers, SFDC Architects to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Ensure solutions adhere to Salesforce best practices for security, performance, and scalability
* Write unit tests and participate in code reviews to maintain code quality
* Support CI/CD pipelines and participate in release management
* Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to ongoing system improvements
* Participate in Agile/Scrum development processes



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 4 \+ Years of Software Development Experience
* Experience developing software on the Salesforce platform
* Experience with Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Understanding of Salesforce security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules)
* Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals (data structures, APIs, testing)
* Experience in Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce
* Experience in Cursor / Agentforce Vibe Coding



  

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

  




* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer I / II, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce Specialist)
* 5\+ Years of Software Development experience
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, or AI\-driven features
* Experience with integration platforms (Boomi, ETL tools)
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies



 Suggested Skills
   

  




* Lightning Web Components
* Apex
* Salesforce security model
* Salesforce Sales Cloud
* Salesforce Data Cloud
* Agentforce



 You will Benefit from our Culture:
   

  

 We strongly believe in the well\-being of our employees and their families. That is why we offer generous health and wellness programs and time away for employees of all levels

We align business strategy with digital execution — defining clear positioning, building credible digital assets, and driving performance\-led growth through accountable systems.

Our approach is disciplined, data\-driven, and outcome\-focused. We build scalable digital foundations that strengthen brand authority, improve conversion performance, and create measurable business impact.

**Role Overview** We are seeking a skilled, self\-driven, and accountable Full Stack Developer capable of independently handling end\-to\-end development across multiple projects.

The role involves:

* Frontend development using React.js and Tailwind CSS
* Backend API development using Node.js and Express
* Database design and management using PostgreSQL
* Third\-party API integrations
* Deployment and server management
* Cross\-functional collaboration with design and marketing teams

This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of features, delivers with consistency, and can manage multiple project timelines without constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Frontend Development**

* Build responsive, pixel\-accurate UIs using React.js and Tailwind CSS
* Convert designs or wireframes into functional interfaces
* Ensure cross\-browser and mobile compatibility
* Maintain component structure and code reusability

**2\. Backend Development**

* Design and develop RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express
* Implement business logic, middleware, and error handling
* Manage authentication and session flows
* Ensure API security and performance

**3\. Database Management**

* Design relational schemas using PostgreSQL or MySQL
* Write efficient queries, handle migrations and indexing
* Maintain data integrity across modules

**4\. API Integrations**

* Integrate payment gateways, messaging services, and cloud storage APIs
* Handle webhooks, callbacks, and third\-party authentication flows
* Document integrations clearly for team reference

**5\. Deployment \& Server Management**

* Deploy applications on Linux\-based VPS environments
* Configure Nginx, PM2, SSL certificates
* Monitor uptime, handle basic server troubleshooting

**6\. Code Quality \& Collaboration**

* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-commented code
* Use Git for version control — commits, branching, pull requests
* Collaborate with the team on project requirements and timelines
* Participate in internal reviews and deliver on deadlines

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

**Mandatory**

* 1–3 years of hands\-on full stack development experience
* Strong in React.js — hooks, state management, routing, API calls
* Proficient in Node.js and Express — REST API design and middleware
* Comfortable with PostgreSQL or MySQL — schemas, queries, joins
* Experience integrating at least one third\-party API
* Git proficiency — branching, commits, pull requests
* Has a GitHub profile or at least one live/deployed project to demonstrate

**Preferred**

* Linux server deployment experience (Nginx, PM2, SSL)
* Familiarity with cloud storage or CDN services
* Exposure to WhatsApp Business API or messaging integrations
* Prior experience handling multiple projects simultaneously
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines

**Who Should Apply**

* Candidates who can demonstrate real work — GitHub, live projects, or portfolio

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

**About the Role**

**The Product Manager – Payroll, Time \& Attendance Tech** will play a key role within the Enterprise Applications team in Haleon’s Digital \& Tech organization, supporting HR, Legal \& Compliance systems. This pivotal role will be a part of our Digital Technology team, reporting directly to the **Senior Product Manager \- Payroll, Time \& Attendance Tech**. This role partners closely with HR teams, technology teams, and external vendors to deliver robust, scalable, and compliant payroll and time systems. It focuses on driving functional design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Workday and payroll vendor solutions. The position is critical in ensuring seamless integration, standardization, and optimization of end\-to\-end HR technology processes. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a global transformation journey while shaping future\-ready HR tech capabilities.

**Role Responsibilities**

* Define, implement, and optimize Payroll Tech systems (Workday and vendor SaaS solutions) and Time \& Attendance systems
* Collaborate with HR business teams, Tech Product teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver effective solutions
* Lead functional design, system configuration, and integration efforts across payroll and time systems
* Manage and support end\-to\-end HR Tech operability, ensuring standardization and continuous improvement
* Oversee change and release management activities, including SaaS updates and production deployments
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, security standards, and external regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX)
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, test cases, and documentation
* Communicate system changes, impacts, and updates effectively to HR and Payroll stakeholders
* Troubleshoot system issues, identify root causes, and implement resolutions or workarounds
* Support global deployments with localization considerations across regions
* Work closely across time zones, particularly aligning with Americas stakeholders

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline
* 8\+ years of experience working with enterprise HR/payroll solutions
* Strong experience in payroll processes, integrations, and technical requirements
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (including PECI, Studio, Web Services, XSLT, etc.)
* Experience with payroll vendor SaaS platforms such as ADP, SD Worx, or similar
* Proven ability to gather and translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Experience managing releases, changes, and SaaS updates in production environments
* Strong understanding of HR, Payroll, and Time \& Attendance processes across enterprise systems
* Ability to navigate complex integrations (SAP, banking systems, file transfers, etc.)
* Strong problem\-solving skills with experience in issue troubleshooting and resolution
* Effective communication skills, especially in articulating system impacts to stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on global implementations with localization requirements
* Prior experience collaborating with third\-party vendors and service providers
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as SOX and enterprise risk management practices
* Experience working in cross\-functional, global, and matrixed environments
* Exposure to secure file exchange and advanced system integration techniques
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across business and technical teams
* Experience driving continuous improvement and transformation initiatives in HR Tech
* Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones in a global organization
* Familiarity with enterprise application ecosystems within large organizations


This role is based in \- Bangalore

description:
Job requisition ID :: 104820
Date: May 21, 2026
Location: Hyderabad
Designation: Manager
Entity: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP
**T\&T\- HC\- HRT\- SF EC Payroll\- Manager\- Hyderabad**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 104820
* **Location**: Hyderabad
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

Today’s business challenges present a new wave of HR, talent and organization priorities. Deloitte’s Human Capital services leverage research, analytics, and industry insights to help design and execute critical programs from business driven HR to innovative talent, leadership, and change programs. Learn more about Human Capital Practice
**Work you’ll do**
==================

  



As an SAP HCM Payroll Consultant, you will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting SAP Payroll solutions for our clients in India. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand their specific payroll needs, translate those needs into technical requirements, and deliver effective solutions within the SAP HCM landscape, ensuring compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements in India.


* **Requirements Gathering \& Analysis (India Focus):** Conduct workshops and interviews with business users in India to gather requirements specific to Indian payroll, including statutory compliance, tax deductions, allowances, and other relevant areas. Analyze business processes and document "as\-is" and "to\-be" scenarios, considering the nuances of Indian payroll.
* **Solution Design \& Configuration (India Focus):** Design, configure, and test SAP Payroll for India, including components like payroll schema, rules, wage types, and tax calculations, ensuring adherence to Indian legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Income Tax, PF, ESI, Gratuity, etc.).
* **Statutory Compliance (India Focus):** Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of Indian payroll regulations and ensure that the SAP Payroll system is configured to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Manage and implement any changes required due to legal updates.
* **Customization \& Development (India Focus):** Develop functional specifications for custom enhancements related to Indian payroll and work with ABAP developers to ensure proper implementation. May also be involved in basic ABAP debugging related to payroll.
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance (India Focus):** Develop test plans, conduct unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) specifically for Indian payroll processes to ensure the quality and accuracy of SAP Payroll solutions.
* **Training \& Documentation (India Focus):** Create user manuals, training materials, and other documentation specific to Indian payroll processes. Conduct end\-user training sessions for Indian payroll users.
* **Go\-Live \& Support (India Focus):** Support the go\-live process for Indian payroll implementations, including data migration and post\-implementation support. Provide ongoing support to end\-users in India, troubleshooting payroll issues and resolving problems.
* **Project Management:** Contribute to project planning, execution, and tracking. Manage tasks and deliverables within assigned scope.
* **Best Practices \& Standards:** Stay up\-to\-date with SAP HCM best practices and Indian payroll regulations and trends. Contribute to the development of internal methodologies and standards related to Indian payroll.
* **Client Communication (India Focus):** Communicate effectively with clients in India, both verbally and in writing, considering cultural nuances. Build and maintain strong client relationships.

  


**Key Skills \& Experience:**
* 6\-8 years in SAP Payroll, with 5\+ years in **Employee Central Payroll (ECP)**.
* Strong knowledge of **Payroll Control Center (PCC)**, **BIB integrations**, and **EC–ECP data replication**.
* Experience with **payroll schemas, PCRs, off\-cycle payroll, and retro\-calculations**.
* Excellent understanding of **Time, Benefits, and Finance integration touchpoints**.
* SAP SuccessFactors ECP certification preferred.
* Strong client\-facing, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Bachelors or Masters in any field.

title: Customer Success Operations Coordinator, APAC
description:
**Company Overview**



Revinate is a direct booking platform that leads the hospitality industry in driving direct revenue and increased profitability.



Our products and our people combine to give hoteliers the superpowers they need to crush their goals. With Revinate, hoteliers shift share away from OTAs and drive tangible results across an individual property or a portfolio. Our industry\-leading, AI\-powered, customer data platform collects, unifies and, synthesizes data giving hoteliers a foundational advantage.



Hoteliers gain critical intelligence – guest lifetime spend, stay preferences, ancillary revenue, and more. With Revinate’s Rich Guest Profile® data points, hoteliers don’t need to guess who their most profitable guests are, or how to drive conversions across email, voice, messaging, and digital channels.



Revinate's direct booking platform and omnichannel communication technology powers 1\.1 billion Rich Guest Profiles across 12,500\+ hotels to drive over $24 billion in direct revenue.



Be a superhero. Join the mission. Transform the industry.


**Get Revinate. Get superpowers.**


**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Operations Coordinator is a critical execution engine for our APAC Customer Success team. In this supportive role, you will act as the operational "right hand" to our Strategic CSMs, removing administrative hurdles and ensuring high\-velocity execution across multiple time zones.



You will be a "Superuser" of the Revinate suite, blending data reporting, technical troubleshooting, and project coordination. This role is ideal for someone detail\-oriented and process\-driven who wants to learn the inner workings of global account management while delivering a "delightful" service experience to our customers.

  


This is a remote position, but candidates must reside within India based on immediate territory needs.
### **Primary Goals**


* **Operational Excellence:** Execute recurring administrative, contract, and billing tasks for Global Accounts with accuracy.
* **Account Readiness:** Lead the seamless implementation and launch of new Guest Feedback accounts within the APAC region.
* **Data Integrity:** Generate and audit complex performance reports that demonstrate Revinate’s value to our largest global stakeholders.
* **Efficient Resolution:** Act as the first point of contact for Level 1 support inquiries, ensuring rapid resolution and high customer satisfaction.
### **What You Will Do**


#### **Global Account \& Operations Support**


* **Administrative Management:** Manage the lifecycle of Global Account paperwork, including contract amendments, renewals, cancellations, and transfers. As well as supporting the Strategic CSM with administration tasks.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate with Billing and Sales to resolve payment disputes, credit memo requests, and debt collection inquiries for Global Accounts.
* **Data \& Reporting:** Produce and audit recurring performance reports for Strategic CSMs to share during Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
* **Alignment:** Participate in daily APAC CS stand\-ups to ensure regional alignment and track the status of global task requests.

#### **Implementation \& Onboarding**


* **Project Management:** Lead the implementation of contracted Revinate products (specifically Guest Feedback) for APAC customers.
* **Technical Launch:** Coordinate with customers and internal technical teams to ensure integrations are completed on time.

#### **Level 1 Technical Support**


* **Queue Management:** Own and respond to Level 1 customer inquiries via Zendesk, maintaining high visibility and responsiveness.
* **Troubleshooting:** Solve non\-standard requests and troubleshoot web\-related issues (browser settings, email rendering, etc.) before escalating complex bugs to Engineering.
* **System Integrity:** Track and log all customer issues in Salesforce to maintain a "source of truth" for the global team.
### **What You Will Bring**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of professional experience in a SaaS environment, preferably in Customer Success, Support, or Operations.
* **Process Mastery:** You thrive in a dynamic environment and are comfortable managing repetitive, process\-driven work at a high velocity.
* **Communication:** Professional written and verbal communication skills, with a high degree of sensitivity to cultural expectations across the APAC region.
* **Technical Savvy:** Interest in learning new products quickly; experience with Salesforce, Zendesk, or JIRA is highly preferred.
* **Detail Orientation:** You are highly organized and proactive in following up on tasks to ensure nothing "falls through the cracks."
* **Hospitality Affinity:** Previous experience in hospitality or familiarity with hotel systems (OPERA, roomMaster, etc.) is a significant plus.
### **What We Can Offer**

* **Tools \& Tech:** We empower you with the hardware and training to become a product expert.
* **Culture:** A focus on learning and professional development within a passionate, high\-performing team.
* **Meaningful Work:** An opportunity to make a major impact on the hospitality industry by supporting its most influential global brands.

**Interview Process**
We're excited you're considering a career with Revinate! Our goal is to ensure this is the right opportunity for you, while also determining if you're the right fit for our team. The interview process for this role is designed to be a two\-way street, where you'll get to know us just as we get to know you.

\- Recruiter Screen \- 30 minutes via WhatsApp
\- Hiring Manager Interview \- 30 minutes via Google Meet
\- Interview with Team Members \- 45 minutes via Google Meet
\- Final Interview with Team Director \- 30 minutes via Google Meet  



Revinate values the flexibility of a remote workforce and the benefits of localized hiring. We focus on specific cities to foster local communities and enhance team cohesion, allowing employees to collaborate, attend local events, and build a strong sense of community and company culture.
**Candidates must be located in the city listed in the job application. Thank you!**

Revinate is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complementary.  


**Important Security Alert**
We have been made aware of fraudulent activities involving individuals impersonating our HR team and offering fake job opportunities. Please be vigilant and ensure your safety by verifying all job offers.

**For Authentic Opportunities:** Only refer to our official careers page on our company website. Your security is our priority. If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately. Stay safe and secure! You can confirm or inquire with any questions by reaching out to recruiting@revinate.com  



**AI and Hiring**
*Please note that interviews at Revinate will be recorded using* *brighthire.ai**. As we continue to build more structure into our interview processes \- the best way to eliminate unconscious bias! We are encouraging our interviewers to focus more on our candidates and the conversation than taking notes. Instead, we can rely on* *brighthire.ai* *to do the note taking for us. If you’re uncomfortable with recording your interview, please let us now. We’ll opt you out.*\#LI\-remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: People Success Manager
description:
Who We Are
 



 HROnTips isn't just another HR company. We’re a pack of innovators building AI tools that revolutionize how companies hire, engage, and grow their teams. We eat our own dog food—using cutting\-edge AI in everything we do.
 



  





 The Mission, Should You Choose to Accept It
 



 Your mission is simple but powerful: build a world\-class team and culture that mirrors our revolutionary AI products. You won't just manage policies; you'll be the architect of our employee experience, a brand ambassador to talent, and a strategic partner in our hyper\-growth.
 



 We need someone who doesn't just "do HR" but lives and breathes the startup hustle. If you're the person friends come to for advice, if you love tech, if you can chat with a software engineer, strategize with the founder, and wow a potential hire all before lunch—this is your stage.
 



  





 Who We're Looking For (The "HR Athlete")
 


* A Culture Creator: You have the energy to build traditions, foster collaboration, and make HROnTips an unforgettable place to work. You think in experiences, not just processes.
* A Talent Magnet \& Storyteller: You’re fluent in the language of both tech and people. You can sell our vision to a top AI engineer and spot raw potential in a brilliant fresher. Your flawless communication turns our mission into a compelling story.
* A Tech\-Savvy Problem Solver: You’re curious about AI and HR tech. You’re eager to use (and give feedback on) our own AI tools to streamline hiring, onboarding, and engagement.
* A Trusted Go\-To Person: You balance empathy with execution. Employees feel heard, leaders feel supported, and you get things done with speed.



  





 Your Playground (Key Responsibilities)
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Employer Branding:
 


* Lead full\-cycle recruitment for all roles—from AI wizards to marketing mavericks.
* Craft innovative sourcing campaigns (think social media, tech communities, hackathons).
* Be the face of HROnTips, building our reputation as the coolest HR tech company to work for.



 2\. Employee Experience \& Operations:
 


* Design and run engagement initiatives (feedback loops, wellness challenges, epic team events).
* Own HR operations with our tech stack—payroll, benefits, and our own AI\-powered tools.
* Ensure a seamless, wow\-worthy experience from offer letter to offboarding.



 3\. Performance \& Growth Catalyst:
 


* Implement lightweight, effective performance and development frameworks.
* Identify skill gaps and coordinate killer training sessions.
* Help chart growth paths so our people grow as fast as our company.



 4\. Strategic Business Partner:
 


* Analyze people data to provide insights on attrition, hiring, and engagement.
* Collaborate directly with the founder and department heads on people strategy.
* Stay ahead of HR tech trends to keep us at the cutting edge.



 Qualifications \& Mindset
 



 ✔ 1\-4 years in HR, Tech Recruitment, or a related people\-centric role (experience in startups, SaaS, or HR tech is a huge plus!).
 



 ✔ Exceptional freshers are aggressively welcome! Show us you've led campus initiatives, built a community, or have a knack for bringing people together.
 



 ✔ Tech\-curious and agile. You’re comfortable with modern tools and eager to learn.
 



 ✔ Outstanding communication skills (English fluency is key)—you’re as confident presenting as you are writing a crisp email.
 



 ✔ A people\-first, results\-driven attitude. You care deeply, but you also execute relentlessly.
 



  





 Why You’ll Absolutely Love It Here
 



 ✅ Ownership \& Impact: Work directly with the founders. See your ideas implemented. No corporate layers.
 



 ✅ Live the Future of HR: Use the most advanced AI HR tools before anyone else.
 



 ✅ Fuel for Growth: Free daily lunches, a learning stipend, and a culture that champions your development.
 



 ✅ Build a Legacy: This isn't just a job. It's a chance to build the HR function of a future global AI brand from the ground up.
 



 ✅ Fast\-Track Trajectory: Prove yourself, and grow into a Head of People/CHRO role as we scale.

title: Employee Relations Manager, INOPS EXR
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work reactively on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
*Resolver operates as a hybrid workforce with the option to work at home, in the office, or a mix of both. Ideally we're looking for someone who's able to collaborate in person in our Hyderabad office once or twice a week.*  


We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our team and help scale hiring across North America. You’ll partner closely with hiring leaders and act as a trusted advisor. This role sits within Resolver’s Talent Acquisition team, with approximately 50% of your time dedicated to supporting hiring efforts across Kroll.

This is an opportunity to shape how we hire — from building smart recruiting strategies to delivering a standout candidate experience from first touch to offer stage. You thrive in full\-cycle recruitment, move quickly, think creatively, and know how to attract top talent in competitive markets.

You know great hiring doesn’t come from simply posting jobs and hoping for the best. You’re proactive, curious, and always experimenting with new ways to connect with talent. Reporting to the Talent Acquisition Lead, you’ll play a key role in helping us grow the teams that power Resolver’s success.  

**About Resolver:**
Resolver is a high\-growth SaaS company whose intuitive, no\-code platform gives our customers a clear picture of their risks so they can make quick and effective decisions. As a part of the Resolver team, your work will help transform risk management to risk intelligence so organizations can protect people and assets and deliver on their purpose.
We are ambitious in both our mission and our culture. As a business within Kroll, we offer an innovative, non\-hierarchical work environment blended with the stability and financial security of an enterprise.  

**Your day to day \- let's break it down!:****Recruitment (85%)***Measures of Success: Quality of hires, fill\-ratio, time\-to\-fill, and source of hire** Engage talent: Identify the right people, get them engaged, and lead the candidate experience through the full hiring process
* Build strategic relationships with hiring teams: We are a global and forward\-thinking team which means you will work with a variety of roles both technical and commercial. You will craft and enhance a consistent and outstanding candidate experience
* Source high quality candidates: You will leverage all talent acquisition channels – networking, events, headhunting, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, etc. This may include targeted recruiting efforts for specific teams.
* Lead candidate searches: With a strong lens on diversity and inclusion, be a trusted resource for how critical inclusive talent strategies are to truly finding the best candidate for the role and Resolver.
* Champion and foster our hiring process: Provide a consistent experience with the Resolver recruiting team
* Participate with the global recruiting team: Help develop, implement, and execute recruiting strategies. Our distributed model means working with global teams and candidates, with the freedom to focus on the right candidate, regardless of location.
* Be a passionate Resolver brand ambassador before, during, and after recruitment. Help us build our talent brand in addition to our talent pipeline

**Talent Acquisition (15%)***Measures of Success: Acceleration of talent acquisition initiatives** Act as a champion within the Talent Team to build the overall talent acquisition strategy and expand our employer brand
* Assists with the Talent Team’s event strategy to build a diverse team of Resolverites
* Attends technology industry networking events to build our talent pipeline
* Work on projects as needed to improve the efficiency of the Resolver recruitment engine

**What you will bring:*** 3\-5 years of recruiting experience across a range of positions and teams, ideally from both and agency and corporate environment with experience hiring technical roles
* Experience collaborating with and influencing hiring managers and executives throughout the recruiting cycle. A passion for understanding what makes the right match for Resolver.
* Experience recruiting for a fast\-paced company. Maybe it's a software company and, better yet, even a company where talent isn't knocking down your door
* Champion diversity \- go beyond the corporate speak of DEI recruiting to be what a true champion is \- focused, energized, takes the time to master the art and science, becomes an authority and is someone the team looks up to.
* Solid understanding of ATS tools (JobVite or Oracle Recruiting Cloud are a bonus!) and recruiting technologies
* Ability to effectively articulate the Resolver value proposition and story to candidates

**What we’ll give you in return**
Culture isn't just something we write about (although we do), we live our values and challenge each other to be our best selves. We invest in Resolverites who will grow with us. We have a comprehensive rewards package to show our team our appreciation for everything they do:


* Great benefits: 100% paid by us for health, accident and life, medical privileges include dental and outpatient too. We also offer a wellness/fitness reimbursement, that can go towards things like gym memberships, yoga classes, soccer membership fees or a cycle.
* Vacation: It’s important for you to have time off to re\-charge your battery and be with your family and friends. Paid time and sick/casual accrual are 15 days and 12 days per year respectively.
* Team: we have smart, talented and curious people you'll work with and learn from. As a Product company, you'll be hands\-on with our global teams and top\-tier leadership in Canada, the US, and UK
* Professional development: we have an external learning budget to help you grow and develop. We also have great online learning and workshops internally for you to tap in to.  

Impact: we solve complex challenges for some of the world's most recognized organizations. Our customers use our software to help reduce the frequency and severity of negative events to protect people, product and organizational success. What we do matters.
* Parental leave: we support new Mothers with 100% top\-up Maternity leave is up to 26 weeks and new Fathers receive 10 days of Welcome Leave.
* Office perks: our environment is flexible, with great snacks and chai. We love our newly renovated office and table tennis. We do socials and events for people to come together.
* Learning: we invest in the development of our people through online learning, group learning and external learning.

**Interested?**
Resolver is committed to providing accommodations for all persons with disabilities. If at any point in the recruitment process you require accommodation, please notify the applicable recruiter or contact us directly at careers@resolver.com

title: Senior Manager, Global Talent Management & OD – Assessments & Culture
description:
Job Description:
**Mission**
-----------


The Senior Manager, Global Talent Management \& OD serves as Schneider Electric’s global expert and strategic advisor on assessments, culture diagnostics, and organization development methodology. This role ensures the ethical, consistent, and high\-impact use of the Schneider Electric Assessment Suite and plays a pivotal role in shaping culture insights in mergers \& acquisitions (M\&A) and in the enterprise\-wide deployment of Upward Feedback. Operating in a sophisticated, global matrix environment, the role strengthens leadership effectiveness, organizational health, and the maturity of Talent Management capabilities worldwide.**Reporting Structure**
-----------------------


This role reports to the VP Global Talent \& Organizational Development and partners closely with the global Talent Management leadership community, HRBPs, the M\&A team, and regional/country HR networks to drive adoption, quality, and impact of assessment and culture tools across Schneider Electric.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Global Assessments Governance \& Expertise**

* Serve as the global owner and governance lead for the Schneider Electric Assessment Suite, ensuring validated, ethical, and contextually appropriate use across geographies.
* Provide expert consulting, advisory support, and coaching to Talent Management professionals and HR colleagues on assessment selection, application, interpretation, and integration into talent decisions.
* Build capability across the global Talent Management community by enabling skill\-building, guidance, and best\-practice sharing to increase adoption and impact of assessments.
* Continuously evaluate new tools, trends, and methodologies to keep the assessment suite modern, evidence\-based, and aligned with business needs.
* Run collective analytics with vendors and shape insights to influence leadership actions and development. Also connect with topics like One Voice, Culture etc.

### **Driving Governance and Utilization of Assessments Across Entities**

* ExCom People Committee: Work closely with SVP TIC and VP Global TM\&OD to ensure use of assessments in selection processes for key SVP Positions raised in monthly ExCom People Committees. Key collaborators include Entity TMs, Executive Recruitment
* Shape the back\-end transformation of assessment administration with the Talent Services Team. Focus on simplification of all processes to make assessment administration efficient and effective.

### **Personally Lead Annual Assessment Exercises for Target Populations**

* External Assessment Centers with vendors like Heidrick \& Struggles, Korn Ferry etc.
* Internal Assessment Centers for key populations like GTPs, Tech Leaders etc. to determine potential for talent acceleration and chart development
* Work in Mission Based teams to design and personally deliver the assessment centers

### **Culture Assessment in M\&A**

* Partner with the M\&A team to assess organizational culture in potential acquisitions and integrations, leveraging validated diagnostic instruments.
* Provide expert interpretation of culture insights to inform decision\-making, risk identification, and integration planning.
* Take ownership of instruments and process design for culture assessments, including evolving tools and approaches.
* Participate hands\-on in select culture assessments, shaping recommendations for leaders and HR partners.

### **Enterprise Ownership of Upward Feedback**

* Lead the global deployment of Upward Feedback, enabling managers to receive structured, behavior\-based feedback aligned with the Impact Leader Code.
* Strengthen quality and adoption of the process through communication, user experience improvements, and change management.
* Partner with HRBP and Talent communities to translate insights into development plans and leadership action.
* Continuously enhance the design and methodology of Upward Feedback to meet evolving leadership expectations.

-----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8\+ years of experience in Talent Management, Organizational Development, or Assessment\-related roles.
* Demonstrated expertise in psychometrics, assessments, culture diagnostics, or leadership evaluation tools. Great to have experience in Assessment Tools like: Hogan, Insights by Discovery, Leadership Versatility Index, Growth Leader Assessment
* Assessment Centre Development and deployment skills in global contexts also a great to have

title: Delivery Coordinator
description:
**We are hiring a Delivery Coordinator to join our engineering delivery team. This is an entry\-level role designed for freshers who are organized, proactive, and want to build a career at the intersection of project management and quality assurance.**  
**Your job is simple to describe but challenging to do well: make sure the projects you support are delivered on time. You will not write code, you will not design test cases on your own, and you will not handle clients. Instead, you will be the person who keeps everyone honest about commitments, surfaces problems early, and makes sure nothing slips through the cracks.**  
**You will work alongside experienced PMs, QAs, and engineers who will train you. Over 12–18 months, you can grow into a full Delivery Coordinator role with ownership of multiple projects.**

**What You'll Do (Day to Day)**

* Attend daily standups and take notes on what every team member committed to — and follow up the next day to check if it actually happened.
* Maintain the project tracker (JIRA / ClickUp) — make sure every ticket has a clear status, owner, and due date. Chase team members to update stale tickets.
* Help the PM prepare sprint plans by listing pending stories, dependencies, and blockers.
* Track QA cycles — when testing starts, how many bugs are open, when signoff is expected — and flag delays early.
* Maintain a simple risk and blocker list for each project; nudge owners to resolve them.
* Prepare weekly delivery status updates for the PM and engineering leads — what's on track, what's at risk, what needs attention.
* Coordinate release readiness checks — make sure deployment steps, smoke tests, and signoffs are completed before any release goes live.
* Sit in on demos and retrospectives, take notes, and convert feedback into tracked action items.

**What We're Looking For**  
This role is about attitude and habits more than experience. We will train you on tools and processes. What we cannot train is:

* Genuine ownership — when something is on your list, it gets done. You do not need to be reminded twice.
* Comfort with follow\-up — you are okay nudging an engineer or QA five times in a day to keep work moving. You do not feel awkward asking 'is this done yet?'
* Attention to detail — you notice when a ticket is missing a due date, when a status hasn't been updated for three days, when a deployment checklist has a step that was skipped.
* Clear written communication in English — short, factual updates without unnecessary jargon.
* Curiosity about software — you do not need to code, but you should be interested in how software is built, tested, and shipped.
* Patience and steadiness — delivery work is repetitive and detail\-heavy. You should find satisfaction in things running smoothly, not chaos.

**Eligibility**

* Any graduate (B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc, BBA, B.Com, or equivalent)
* Comfortable working from our Lucknow office full\-time.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic familiarity with any project tracking tool (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong written and spoken English.

**What You'll Learn**  
**In your first 6 months, you will get hands\-on exposure to:**

* How real software projects are planned, estimated, and delivered to paying clients.
* Agile and Scrum practices in a working environment, not a textbook.
* Industry\-standard tools — JIRA, Slack, GitHub, staging environments, deployment pipelines.
* How QA, engineering, design, and PM functions work together — and how to spot when one of them is becoming a bottleneck.
* How to communicate risk and status clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable working from our Lucknow office full\-time.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic familiarity with any project tracking tool (or willingness to learn quickly).
* Strong written and spoken English.

title: Sales Executive / Outreach
description:
**\#\# Job Description: Business Development Executive**

We are hiring a full\-time Business Development Executive who can help the company generate leads, communicate with potential clients, follow up with prospects, and support business growth through outreach and client relationship building.

The ideal candidate should be confident in communication, comfortable with sales conversations, and able to understand client requirements clearly. This role is suitable for someone who is target\-driven, organized, and interested in learning sales, marketing, and client acquisition.

\#\# Role Details

Job Title: Business Development Executive

Role Type: Full\-time

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

Salary: ₹1000 per month \+ 10% to 20% commission on each sale

Experience: Fresher to 1 year preferred

Work Mode: As per company requirement

\#\# About the Role

As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for identifying potential clients, reaching out to prospects, explaining company services, maintaining follow\-ups, and helping convert leads into clients.

You will work closely with the marketing and sales team to manage leads from different sources such as social media, ads, referrals, cold outreach, and inbound enquiries.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# 1\. Lead Generation

Identify potential clients through online research, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and other lead sources.

This includes:

Finding relevant business prospects

Creating and maintaining lead lists

Researching company details and decision\-makers

Identifying client needs and business opportunities

Supporting outreach campaigns

\#\#\# 2\. Client Outreach

Reach out to potential clients through calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn, and other communication channels.

You will be responsible for:

\- Introducing the company and its services  
\- Starting conversations with potential clients  
\- Understanding client requirements  
\- Sharing service details and proposals when needed

Following up regularly with interested prospects

\#\#\# 3\. Lead Nurturing and Follow\-Ups

Maintain consistent communication with prospects and move them through the sales process.

This includes:  
\- Following up with warm leads  
\- Answering basic client questions  
\-Scheduling meetings or calls  
\- Updating lead status regularly  
\- Keeping track of conversations and next steps

\#\#\# 4\. Client Requirement Understanding

Understand the client’s business needs and share the right information with the internal team.

You should be able to:

\- Ask the right questions  
\- Understand pain points  
\- Identify suitable services  
\- Share clear client briefs with the team  
\- Help prepare basic proposals or service recommendations

\#\#\# 5\. Sales Coordination

Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth communication and conversion.

This includes:

\- Sharing client details with the concerned team  
\- Coordinating meetings  
\- Keeping records of leads and conversions  
\- Updating daily sales activity  
\- Supporting proposal and quotation follow\-ups

\#\#\# 6\. Target Achievement

Work towards monthly lead generation and conversion targets.

You will be expected to:  
\- Maintain daily outreach activity  
\- Generate qualified leads  
\- Convert interested prospects into meetings  
\- Support client onboarding  
\- Achieve sales and commission goals

\#\# Required Skills

Good communication skills

Basic understanding of sales and business development

Confidence in calling and client conversations

Ability to follow up professionally

Good research and lead generation skills

Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, and Google Sheets

Ability to understand client requirements

Positive attitude and willingness to learn

Target\-driven mindset

Good time management skills

\#\# Preferred Skills

Experience in sales, business development, or client servicing

Knowledge of digital marketing, branding, IT, or creative services

Basic understanding of CRM or lead tracking tools

Comfortable with cold calling and cold outreach

Ability to write simple sales messages and follow\-up texts

\#\# Monthly Responsibilities

Generate new leads

Reach out to prospects through calls, messages, emails, and LinkedIn

Maintain lead sheets and update follow\-up status

Schedule meetings with interested clients

Coordinate with the internal team for proposals and service details

Follow up with prospects until closure

Support client onboarding after conversion

Achieve monthly sales and lead targets

\#\# Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys talking to people, understands basic sales conversations, and is willing to learn how business development works.

This role is best suited for someone who is proactive, confident, consistent with follow\-ups, and motivated by both fixed salary and commission\-based growth.

title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for SCADA software and network infrastructure
* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures
* Document alarm handling and data logging processes
* Create end\-user and admin operation guides
* Develop assembly work instructions
* Prepare electrical work instructions and wiring routing for SCADA panels
* Work on product specifications and engineering circuit drawings
* Manage BoM and components documentation
* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (SCADA engineers, software developers, OT/IT teams, vendors) to gather source content
* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines
* Regularly update documentation based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, and new deployments


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
* Experience working in Agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics using NX software / SEE Electrical software


**About The Team**
 You will be part of a collaborative and cross\-functional team supporting SCADA systems and wind energy solutions. The team works closely across engineering, software, and operations functions to ensure accurate documentation and smooth system deployment.
   

  

 The environment encourages knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and high\-quality documentation practices, enabling teams to effectively operate and maintain wind turbine systems while contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Gamesa?**
 Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.
   

  

 Empowering our people https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees
   

  

 How do you imagine the future? https://youtu.be/12Sm678tjuY
   

  

 Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions \- the greatest challenge we face.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
