title: Frontend Engineer (India)
description:
**About Onehouse**
 Onehouse is a mission\-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock\-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud\-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute\-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real\-time AI / ML).
   

  

 We are a team of self\-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large\-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self\-optimizing data lake platform!
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2\-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category \- the transactional data lake. The Product Engineering team is the glue that binds all of this together. We enable our data platform and infrastructure teams to be successful by acting as the foundation of a truly cloud native product.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Drive:**
* You aren't just building a UI; you are building the command center for the transactional data lake. Your work sits at the intersection of complex distributed systems and high\-performance user interfaces.
* Architecting AI\-Native Data Experiences: You will lead the development of generative AI interfaces that allow users to talk to their data infrastructure. Imagine building natural language interfaces that auto\-generate schemas or debug complex data pipelines in real\-time.
* Visualizing Massive Scale: You’ll solve the "dense data" problem—crafting performant, intuitive visualizations for petabyte\-scale data flows using React, Next.js and Typescript, ensuring that managing a global data lake feels as simple as managing a spreadsheet.
* Bridging the gRPC Gap: You will help define how we stream complex infrastructure states to the frontend, leveraging gRPC\-web to create a snappy, low\-latency experience that feels "local" even when managing remote cloud clusters.
* Defining a Category: As an early hire, your DNA will be in the product. You’ll influence the UX patterns of a new industry category, moving the needle from "clunky enterprise software" to "elegant cloud\-native platform."


**A Typical Day:**
* No two days are the same in a scaling startup, but here is what your rhythm looks like:
* Getting Started: You start with a sync with your lead engineers. You might be discussing how to build new feature into product with right approach.
* Deep Work Phase: You’re in the zone with Next.js and gRPC, building out a sophisticated features. You’re likely writing new shared components to ensure our UI is as robust as our backend.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: You will work with EM/PMs to discuss upcoming features and define next milestones.
* State Management \& Logic: You spend time optimising our Firebase integration for real\-time notifications or wiring up gRPC services to ensure the frontend is perfectly synced with the underlying infrastructure.
* Direct Impact: You ship code that immediately improves how our customers interact with transactional data.
* Oncall: You will build alerts, logging and sophisticated tooling to make sure customer experience never degrades.


**What You Bring to the Table:**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Frontend engineer with experience developing and operating frontend applications
* Experience with React and gRPC.
* Operational excellence in monitoring/deploying/testing frontend applications.
* Great problem\-solving skills, a keen eye for details
* Quick decision making, self\-driven and able to balance to feature development and tech debt
* Clear communication skills
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience with Firebase or equivalent DB.
* Experience working on a SaaS product.


**How We'll Take Care Of You**
* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health \& Well\-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well\-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
* Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well\-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
* Location; we are a remote\-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America \+ India), though some roles will be subject to in\-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 11 paid company holidays
* Food \& Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in\-office snacks/drinks
* Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one\-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
* Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents \- fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition


**House Values**
**One Team**
*Optimize for the company, your team, self \- in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co\-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of.*
**Tough \& Persevering**
*We are building our company in a very large, fast\-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!*
**Keep Making It Better Always**
*Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty\-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward.*
**Think Big, Act Fast**
*We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns.*
**Be Customer Obsessed**
*Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company.*
 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Company Description**
 Global University Systems is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry\-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital\-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M\+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.
   

  

**About Quallege**
 Quallege is an international student recruitment platform that partners with leading U.S. universities to drive enrollment from global markets. We operate at the intersection of higher education and international marketing — working on behalf of our university partners to attract, engage, and convert students across key regions
   

  

 Our work serves three primary audiences:
 **recruitment partners** 
 (the agents and agencies on the ground in each market),
 **prospective students** 
 (the end audience our campaigns are ultimately designed to reach), and
 **university partners** 
 (the institutions we represent, who are active stakeholders in approvals and brand standards). Understanding how to communicate effectively and appropriately for each audience is central to every role on our team.
   

  

 We are a global company with a local mindset. Some of our communications are market\-specific — tailored in tone, cultural context, or language for a particular region — while others follow a global approach applied consistently across all markets. The ability to navigate both is key.
   

  

 Because we produce content on behalf of universities, our work must adhere to each institution's brand guidelines and is often subject to university approval workflows.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a capable and detail\-oriented Web Developer to join Quallege’s marketing team. This is a hands\-on production role focused on two core areas: HTML email development and campaign landing pages. This role is responsible for marketing\-facing digital assets and ensuring our communications render correctly, track properly, and connect seamlessly with our CRM and marketing systems.
   

  

 You bring solid front\-end fundamentals, a quality\-first mindset, and the ability to work across multiple concurrent projects. You understand how websites, forms, and digital assets integrate with CRM platforms, and you can act as an informed liaison between the marketing team and our agency when technical decisions arise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**HTML Email Production**
* Build responsive, cross\-client HTML email templates from design files or briefs using Stripo (or equivalent), coded for compatibility with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, mobile clients and others
* Maintain and update a modular email template library covering campaign types: partner onboarding sequences, university\-specific announcements, event invitations, and newsletters.
* Proactive template development: Actively identify opportunities to templatize recurring email formats, spot inefficiencies in the current setup, and propose reusable structures before being asked.
* Yield\-focused journeys — beyond onboarding, they'll build nurture sequences aimed at moving students further down the funnel (application submission, deposit payment, enrollment confirmation, etc.). These are behaviourally triggered or stage\-based journeys, not just one\-off sends.
* Apply inline CSS and table\-based layouts following email\-safe coding standards; conduct pre\-send rendering QA across major clients and devices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve rendering issues, broken layouts, and display inconsistencies across clients and devices.
* Implement UTM parameters and ensure all links, tracking codes, and CTA elements are correctly configured before deployment.
* Coordinate with the Partner specialist, Copywriter and Design teams to receive brand assets (logos, imagery, fonts) and copy, then independently design and build production\-ready email outputs within agreed timelines.


**Landing Pages \& Web Assets**
* Build and maintain campaign landing pages using Landingi that are responsive, fast\-loading, and optimized for conversion — using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as needed.
* Develop web assets including banners, event registration pages, partner\-facing pages, and promotional components.
* Implement on\-page SEO best practices (semantic HTML, meta tags, alt attributes, page speed considerations) in coordination with the Copywriter.
* Integrate forms, tracking pixels, and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or equivalent) into landing pages.


**CRM \& Systems Integration**
* Ensure web forms, landing pages, and email assets are correctly integrated with Quallege’s CRM (Salesforce or equivalent), passing lead and engagement data accurately.
* Understand and implement UTM and conversion tracking flows so that digital touchpoints feed cleanly into marketing dashboards and attribution reporting.
* Collaborate with the marketing team and external agency to troubleshoot data flow issues between web properties and CRM systems.
* Support the setup and QA of marketing automation workflows that connect email, landing page, and CRM data — working within platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or equivalent.


**UX/UI Design \& Visual Execution**
* Independently design and build HTML emails and landing pages from brief or concept — owning the full process from visual layout and typography to final coded output, without relying on a separate designer.
* Apply UX/UI principles to produce digital assets that are visually polished, on\-brand, intuitive, and optimized for the intended audience — balancing aesthetic quality with technical performance.
* Create design mockups or wireframes in Figma (or equivalent) when needed prior to development, and work within brand guidelines to maintain visual consistency across all digital touchpoints.
* Apply accessibility best practices (WCAG standards) and mobile\-first design thinking to all email and landing page builds, ensuring outputs are functional and visually consistent across devices.


**Agency Liaison \& Standards**
* Act as an informed internal point of contact between the marketing team and the external web agency — understanding technical scopes, reviewing deliverables, and communicating requirements clearly.
* Review and QA agency outputs for marketing\-facing web changes, flagging issues and ensuring brand and functional consistency.
* Document email templates, landing page components, and integration configurations to build a reusable, maintainable asset library.
* Stay current on front\-end development trends, email standards, and CRM integration best practices.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Technology, or related field
* Equivalent professional experience considered in lieu of formal degree


**Desirable**
* Front\-end or web development certification
* UX/UI design coursework or qualification (e.g., Google UX Design Certificate, Interaction Design Foundation)


**Essential**
**Experience \& Skills**
* 3–5 years of professional front\-end or web development experience
* Proven, hands\-on experience building HTML email templates with inline CSS and table\-based layouts, including cross\-client QA
* Experience building and optimizing campaign landing pages for lead generation or conversion
* Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles
* Working knowledge of JavaScript; familiarity with jQuery and ES6
* Demonstrated understanding of CRM integration: connecting web forms, landing pages, and email assets to CRM platforms (Salesforce or HubSpot preferred)
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and how they connect to web and email touchpoints
* Understanding of UTM tracking, Google Analytics (GA4\), and conversion pixel implementation
* Demonstrated ability to independently design and build digital assets (emails and landing pages) — strong visual sensibility with working knowledge of UX/UI principles and design tools (Figma or equivalent)
* Strong attention to detail and a quality\-first approach to testing and QA
* Portfolio demonstrating HTML email work, landing pages, and digital marketing assets


**Desirable**
* Experience with email rendering QA tools (Litmus or Email on Acid); hands\-on familiarity with Stripo and Landingi is a strong plus
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or Mailchimp
* Familiarity with CMS platforms (WordPress or similar)
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2\.1\)
* Experience working alongside or managing relationships with external web agencies
* Exposure to international or multicultural digital marketing environments


*The post holder may be asked to undertake additional duties in line with business requirements. All employees are expected to uphold Quallege’s values and comply with company policies, including those related to equality, diversity, inclusion, and safeguarding.*
**Other Information**
 Please note this position is only available on our consultancy agreement.
   

  

 Global University Systems equal opportunity employer. We provide equal opportunities and are committed to the principle of equality regardless of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, record of offences, marital status, family status or disability. The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager. There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and will comply with the code of conduct as well as equality and diversity, health and safety and safeguarding policies

**Background of The Hans Foundation**  

The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under\-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two\-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North\-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower\-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 57 million beneficiaries through its programs. **Role Description** : The role plays a pivotal role in aligning talent management and development initiatives with business objectives, working closely with business teams at the location to ensure effective implementation. Additionally, the role fosters employee engagement by encouraging active participation in various programs aimed at enhancing workplace culture.

**Purpose :** To implement Talent Management, Talent Development and Engagement processes to cultivate a positive employee experience within the assigned location.

**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Hiring \& Onboarding** \- Organize and conduct Regional Induction Programs for employees to familiarize them with required processes. Conduct 30\-60\-90 connects with new joinees and gather feedback. Prepare action points post feedback and implement the same in discussion with the lead. Track and ensure all new joinee's have received their id cards, assets etc. Assign experienced employees as buddies to assist new joiners and facilitate effective communication between them, fostering a smooth integration process.

**Performance and Rewards** \- Drive goal\-setting process within defined timelines through timely orientation sessions and regular follow\-ups. Initiate confirmation process for all new joinees. Seek inputs for confirmation and ensure timely release of confirmation letters. Drive mid\-year and annual performance appraisal process, and assist in calibration exercise. Initiate PIP for all non\-performing cases in collaboration with business team and ensure appropriate closure. Handle any queries pertaining to goal setting and appraisals. Follow\-up with IT team for timely resolution of any system\-related issues. Collaborate with business teams to complete the annual compensation review process including promotions, ensuring alignment with assigned budgets and defined timelines. Resolve any grievances/ issues pertaining to employee performance \& rewards. Co\-ordinate with respective lead for timely resolution of issues pertaining to incentives / increments.

**Talent Development** \- Ensure execution of trainings as per calendar by liaisoning on internal and external trainers and necessary logistical arrangements for the same. Complete all post training formalities like upload of attendance data, preparation of summary details of training to be emailed to trainer etc. Facilitate the identification of critical roles across departments in coordination with business teams to drive succession planning initiatives. Monitor the closure of Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for eligible employees by maintaining regular follow\-up and tracking progress.

**Emp lifecycle management and HR operations** \- Periodically check with employees for clarity on their job expectations, challenges in managing interdependencies. Co\-ordinate with managers to provide necessary clarity, where needed. Offer insights and recommendations for policy design based on employee feedback and interactions. Conduct retention discussion in partnership with business to reduce attrition levels, conduct exit interviews etc. as part of attrition management. Address employee queries and grievances related to the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) portal and company policies in collaboration with internal teams, ensuring timely and effective resolutions. Manage redesignation, transfer requests, including discussions with the employees, their Manager and HoDs.

**Organizational effectiveness** \- Support in executing periodic programs aimed at engaging the employee\- e.g. Wellness programs, Fun events, Celebration of festivals etc. for the assigned location. Partner with various stakeholders for CSR Programs and encourage employee participation in CSR initiatives. Follow up and seek nominations for various recognition programs and ensure timely submission. Execute various employee engagement activities to inculcate a participatory culture such as Town Halls, Skip level meetings, employee 1\-2\-1s, etc. Drive participation across various teams for vibes survey. Implement the assigned action plan basis the survey findings. Implement various D\&I initiatives and seek active participation from all employees at the location.

**HR Digitization** \- Stay updated on industry best practices and emerging trends in HR digitization and provide inputs on areas of digitization. Actively engage in the implementation of assigned digitization initiatives, to ensure successful integration and adoption of digital solutions. Continuously monitor the performance of digital HR solutions, identify potential issues or areas for improvement, and provide feedback for further evaluation and action. Enforce data security protocols and best practices to safeguard sensitive information.

description:

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


To manage PF, Pension, EDLI and statutory compliance operations, ensuring accurate processing, timely settlements, and full regulatory adherence

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Manage end\-to\-end PF, Pension, EDLI, and statutory compliance operations, including coordination with EPFO, PF Trust, auditors, and internal departments to ensure accurate processing and timely service delivery

**Challenges**:

* Achieving 100% KYC Compliance *(Aadhaar seeding for all members)*
* Ensuring 100% E\-Nomination Completion for all PF members
* Timely Processing and Disbursement of PF Loans
* Zero NC during RPFC Inspections

#### **Key Result Areas**

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**

 **Supporting Actions**

 **PF Operations \& PF Loan Management**

  

* Manage issuance of PF, Special and NR loans for all eligible employee, ensuring accurate calculation and disbursement as per company/trust policy.
* Prepare loan vouchers, loan statements, and ensure proper documentation with employee acknowledgment for audit purposes.
* Perform monthly reconciliation of loan disbursements, EMI deduction, recovery of loan amounts and interest with the Accounts Department/Trust Office.
* Prepare monthly PF contribution, EMI recovery, and interest recovery reports.
 **Pension (EPS) \& EPFO Compliance**

  

* Handle pension\-related claims (monthly pension, withdrawals, transfer, etc.) in compliance with the EPFO Act.
* Prepare and submit required EPFO forms (Form 4, 5, 7, etc.) accurately and on time.
* Fill and manage pension applications through the EPFO portal.
* Manage UAN generation, PF/Pension number allotment to the new joiners
* Ensure prompt processing and closure of pension claims, including special cases (e.g., death cases) as per management guidelines.
* Upload monthly ECR and Update NCP (Non\-Contributory Period) days and ensure accuracy in all statutory filings
 **Coordination with the EPFO Officials and**

**Ensuring 100% Statutory Compliance**

  

* Approve online PF transfer claims and ensure timely KYC updates and approvals through the EPFO portal.
* Submit documents to RPFC on time and maintain regular communication with EPFO/RPFC offices and PF Trust for updates and grievance resolution.
* Maintain complete and accurate records of all pension\-related documents for audit purposes.
* Coordinate and facilitate annual PF inspection, ensuring 100% compliance and documentation readiness.
 **Coordination with the PF trust and** **Ensuring 100% Statutory Compliance**

  

* Ensure compliance with PF Trust rules, EPFO guidelines, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with PF Trust for claim approvals, fund management, and policy implementation
* Process PF Trust claims (advance/withdrawal/settlement) as per Trust rules
* Prepare and submit periodic reports/returns to PF Trust and management
* Coordinate with auditors for PF Trust audit and ensure audit readiness
* Monitor PF contributions, interest calculation, and fund reconciliation with Trust accounts
* Maintain proper records for inspections and statutory audits
 **EDLI \& Insurance Management**

  

* Prepare monthly EDLI statements along with detailed entry and exit reports, and submit them to the concerned insurance office within the prescribed timeline.
* Prepare EDLI payment vouchers for the Accounts Department to enable timely cheque preparation and submission to the insurance office.
* Prepare annual group insurance statements for policy renewal and coordinate with the insurance office for renewal premium and revised rates.
* Prepare EDLI claim statements with required supporting documents and ensure timely submitted the claim for nominees of deceased employees.
* Maintain regular coordination with the insurance office for submissions, renewals, claims, and clarification of issues.
* Handle EDLI inspections as scheduled by RPFC and ensure full compliance.
 **PF Full \& Final Settlement, Annual Closing \& Financial Reconciliation**

  

* Update exit dates promptly upon receipt of exit letters and process full \& final PF settlement for all members as per policy.
* Handle annual retirement settlements and coordinate with PF Trust to arrange required corpus funds for timely disbursement.
* Perform annual PF closing, including reconciliation of member balances, interest calculation, ledger finalization, and preparation of closing statements in compliance with PF Trust and statutory requirements.
* Maintaining operative and in operative ledger.
* Calculate and deduct TDS on applicable PF settlements/interest as per statutory norms and ensure proper reporting.
* Generate and maintain PF passbooks for members, ensuring accuracy and timely availability.

Assist in attendance coordination, employee follow\-ups, and day\-to\-day HR operational activities.

Support the HR team in preparing HR letters, offer letters, internship letters, certificates, and other employee\-related documentation.

**Employee Coordination \& Engagement**

Assist in handling employee queries and basic HR\-related concerns in a professional and timely manner.

Coordinate with employees and departments for HR\-related requirements, updates, and follow\-ups.

Support employee engagement initiatives such as Fun Saturdays, team activities, celebrations, and workplace engagement programs.

Contribute to maintaining a positive and professional work environment.

**Administrative \& Project Support**

Professional communication with candidates, employees, and stakeholders.

Hands\-on learning in a fast\-paced professional services environment.

**Why Join Us**

Hands\-on exposure to real HR processes.

Learning\-focused and growth\-oriented work environment.

Certificate upon successful completion of the internship.

Future growth opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

title: Workday Functional and Product support
description:
**About the Job:**


We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career—with countless opportunities to explore, build meaningful connections, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible.

**Position Overview**


Sanofi is seeking a **Workday Functional and Product support** to join our **Digital P\&C / People Services** team. This is a critical role responsible for the **functional ownership, optimization, and governance** of the Workday **Core HCM and Security framework** across a complex global environment.


You will lead the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday Core HCM while ensuring **secure, compliant, and scalable access control models** that support Sanofi’s global and local HR operations. This position partners closely with HR, IT, Compliance, and Security stakeholders to deliver a seamless, secure employee and manager experience aligned to Sanofi’s strategic objectives.

**Main Responsibilities**

**Workday HCM Configuration \& Optimization**

* Lead the design, configuration, and enhancement of Workday Core HCM and security ensuring best\-in\-class integration with Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, and other downstream systems.
* Analyze and remediate existing Workday tenant configurations to improve global consistency, data quality, system performance, scalability, and user experience.
* Drive harmonization of global core data models while supporting localization requirements for countries and regions.
* Manage security impacts arising from new HCM configurations, releases, acquisitions, and organizational changes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Requirements Management**

* Partner with global and local HR, Payroll, IT, and Security stakeholders to gather, analyze, and clarify complex functional and security\-related requirements.
* Translate business and compliance needs into effective Workday HCM and Security solutions while balancing flexibility, risk, and standardization.
* Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on Workday design decisions, tradeoffs, and best practices.

**Innovation, Releases \& Continuous Improvement**

* Stay up to date with **Workday releases, features, and best practices**, proactively identifying opportunities to improve functionality and controls.
* Lead impact assessments and testing related to Workday releases affecting HCM and Security.
* Support adoption of new features that enhance governance, automation, and employee experience.

**Tenant Management \& Environment Governance**

* Act as the functional owner of the Workday tenant, ensuring stability, consistency, and performance across all environments (Production, Sandbox, Preview, and Implementation tenants).
* Govern tenant\-wide configuration standards, naming conventions, transport rules, and promotion processes.
* Coordinate and oversee Workday release management, including preview testing, impact assessments, regression testing, and go‑live readiness.
* Manage tenant dependencies across HCM, Security, integrations, and downstream systems.
* Ensure proper usage of tenants for testing, training, and deployment in line with internal controls and best practices.

**Compliance, Controls \& Documentation**

* Ensure all configurations and security models comply with **regulatory requirements**, internal audit standards, and Sanofi governance policies.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for HCM configurations, security roles, domains, business processes, and controls.
* Support audits by providing clear traceability of access models, approvals, and system controls.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in Workday HCM, HRIS product management, or digital HR transformation in a global organization.
* Proven experience across functional workstreams, PMO governance, vendor/partner management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with Workday configuration governance and environment/tenant strategies; able to peer coach technical teams (Architect/Config leads) while holding functional accountability.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep expertise in **Workday HCM configuration** and tenant remediation.
* Strong practical knowledge of **Workday Security**, including domains, business process security, roles, and access\-based controls.
* Workday HCM Pro certification preferred; Workday Security experience or certification is a strong plus.
* Experience integrating Workday with local HRIS and third\-party systems is highly desirable.

**Domain \& Business Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of **core HR data models**, employee lifecycle processes, and localization requirements in global organizations.
* Knowledge of HR compliance, data privacy principles, and access governance concepts.
* Ability to translate complex HR and security needs into pragmatic system solutions.

**Advanced Skills**

* Agile mindset and ways of working
* Project management and planning
* Application design and system integration
* Security and compliance of computerized systems
* Strong business acumen
* Collaboration and stakeholder management
* Ability to communicate complexity with clarity and simplicity
* Fluent in English


Why choose us?

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

**Pursue** *Progress*. **Discover** *Extraordinary*.


Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue Progress. And let’s discover Extraordinary together.

Embark on a transformative journey as Team Manager\-Know your Customer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first\-class support to our clients with expertise and care.


Critical role covering, managing the BAU activity for the team to keep regulatory visible KRI within group risk appetite due to increased volumes of clients requiring refresh. * Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.

* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organization.

This role is based out of Gurgaon.

To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.


For our business, for clients, and for you

They will work closely with HRBP’s and other areas of the HR department (L\&D, Integrations, Operations, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, etc.) to execute a diverse array of duties. They will also have considerable interaction with other departments across the group; Finance \& Procurement, Internal Audit, Legal, Marketing, etc.


The successful person will be highly motivated, have exceptional organisational and communication skills, and a talent for attention to detail. We are looking for an enthusiastic and solution focused multi\-tasker who will work well with others as well as on their own initiative to contribute to the success of the organisation by promoting an excellent service.

**The Role \& Key Responsibilities:**

* Benchmark benefits to ensure appropriate positioning in market whilst achieving global harmonisation where possible by developing cost effective recommendations
* Support in developing timely, cost effective and innovative solutions in response to business needs aligned with HR strategy
* Support the review and negotiation of benefit plan renewals
* Assist with benefit due diligence for various projects such as mergers \& acquisitions, supporting key stakeholders to ensure full comparisons are made and any issues/risks are highlighted
* Act as first point of contact for Benefits Set up related queries from local HR teams, escalating where necessary
* Work towards becoming the subject matter expert in relation to Global Benefits Delivery
* Manage the approved vendor \& PO process for new providers
* Support local HR teams on membership reviews to ensure data integrity

**Skills Required:**

* 8\+ years’ broad experience operating Global Benefits schemes, exhibiting progressive responsibility
* Advanced skills in Excel with the ability to data model and present the data to senior management to make informed decisions using PowerPoint
* Strong analytical and numeracy skills with high attention to detail
* Effective vendor management skills; managing contracts and collaboration with stakeholders
* Confident, clear communicator with excellent written and verbal skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders
* A talent for remaining change agile within a dynamic work environment
* Ability to support the full life cycle of complex projects
* A keen interest in supporting continuous improvement demonstrating a history of individual growth and development

**What you will get in return:**

* A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of a large and expanding global business
* Exposure to all aspects of the business with cross\-jurisdictional interaction and direct engagement with senior management
* The ability to thrive in an international business that fosters a supportive and diverse company culture

**Additional information:**


We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio\-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.


We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.

title: Associate Director - Training
description:
**Company:**
------------


Marsh Risk
**Description:**
----------------


We are seeking a talented individual to join our Training (Insurance Operations) team at Marsh Risk, a Marsh business. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.


**Associate Director – Training (Grade F)**

The Senior Learning and Development Specialist will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and delivering comprehensive training programs tailored to the needs of our colleagues in India, and the Pacific region enterprise wide. This role will have a systems and induction training focus, helping colleagues navigate and effectively use our operating systems and processes. At times, the role will be required to step\-in and support other team members on technical training activities.


The role will collaborate closely with internal systems subject matter experts and cross\-functional teams in India and the Pacific region, to ensure delivery of training that is aligned with business goals, systems use requirements and compliance requirements. The role will also have responsibility for the development and ongoing implementation of onboarding and induction training for roles in India who work directly with teams in the Pacific.


**We will count on you to:**

**Systems Training**

* Work with systems subject matter experts and other key stakeholders to determine learning requirements for a variety of audiences – including systems and procedures
* Design and develop high quality and engaging, end\-to\-end systems training courses. This includes , instructional materials, e\-learning modules, instructor\-led courses (virtual hybrid and in\-person), blended learning programs and other materials as required
* Development of learning events and learning pathways using Workday and Degreed platforms
* Oversee the learning management system (LMS) to ensure efficient set up, user engagement and reporting
* Stay up to date with the latest instructional technologies and tools, recommending solutions to enhance learning experience and engagement.
* Develop a process of oversight and governance of regular reviews and updates of system training courses and content in line with system changes and updates.
* Set up a system of regular system refresher training including recording and reporting, aligned to a recommended cadence.
* Direct the maintenance and updating of systems training resources on platforms such as the Marsh Training Hub on SharePoint, Degreed Pathways, Workday Learning,
* Coordinate and support training sessions virtually and in\-person, including facilitation and workshop coordination.
* Deliver internal training on systems to ensure colleagues meet Continuing Education (CE) and Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and business requirements.
* Assist with Workday administration tasks such as mass enrolment forms, course setup, and updating course content.
* Facilitate onboarding plans and induction schedules, collaborating with HR and L\&D teams to align onboarding with talent development initiatives.
* Support the maintenance and updating of training resources on the Marsh Training Hub on the SharePoint platform.
* Coordinate and support training sessions virtually and in\-person, including facilitation and workshop coordination.
* Assist in the creation of CPD reporting and tracking of mandatory course completions.
* Collaborate with centralized teams to design training content related to Marsh Risk.
* Where required, create process maps and training materials related to business systems and procedures.

**Onboarding Experience**

* Facilitate, coordinate and supplement onboarding plans and induction schedules for India roles directly supporting Australia and NZ, collaborating with HR and L\&D teams in Pacific to align onboarding with existing regional or enterprise frameworks and priorities
* Set up a regular review and update onboarding content.
* Provide coaching and guidance to managers on effective onboarding and colleague development practices.
* Ensure compliance with organizational practices, legal requirements and diversity and inclusion standards throughout onboarding
* Monitor and report onboarding metrics and KPIs to senior leadership to demonstrate effectiveness.
* Provide effective reporting of onboarding performance to senior leadership, enabling informed decision\-making

**Technical Training**

* Support exam supervisory requirements and accreditation processes as needed.

**What you need to have:**

* Minimum 10years of experience in learning and development or training roles.
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering digital and virtual learning solutions.
* Experience managing multiple projects and adapting to changing environments.
* Experience with onboarding and talent development initiatives.
* Familiarity with accreditation and compliance training processes.
* Demonstrated experience with Articulate, PowerPoint, SharePoint
* Strong work ethic and commitment to team success.
* Openness to coaching, self\-reflection, and continuous growth.
* Accountability and willingness to take initiative beyond comfort zones.
* Innovative mindset with the ability to inspire and think creatively.
* High ethical standards and integrity.
* Strong ability to understand learning needs, requirements and outcomes and design training that supports that need across a recommended timeframe
* Strong instructional design capability with experience building e\-learning content, using Articulate , Sharepoint, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office suite
* Proficient in digital learning platforms, including Workday, SharePoint, MS Teams, Zoom, and other generative AI tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for virtual and face\-to\-face training.
* Ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple teams in multiple countries
* Ability to work in a changing work environment and demonstrate flexibility and problem\-solving skills
* Should be comfortable with 6\.30am – 3\.30pm shift

**What makes you stand out:**

* Knowledge of insurance industry practices is advantageous but not essential.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.

Marsh Risk is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. title: Senior ERD Manager
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future.

**Key Responsibilities**

 **1\.** **Program Implementation and Strategy Development**

* Lead contextual and market analysis to inform program design and transition strategies from emergency CVA to early recovery and resilience.
* Oversee implementation of MPCA, CFF, GCTs, and livelihood recovery activities in accordance with IRC ERD program strategy and Cash Relief Operating Procedures (CROP) and SCWG/MEB standards.
* Lead program implementation activities at all stages of project cycle by providing guidance and technical direction to officers, field staff and other sectors who include cash transfer in their design.
* Ensure strong integration between emergency cash assistance and sustainable livelihood pathways (VSLA, entrepreneurship, skills training, business grants).
* Ensure inclusive, participatory targeting with strong accountability and safeguarding mechanisms.
* Ensure the payment options guarantee the maximum level of protection towards the beneficiaries.
* Integrate climate\-smart, nutrition\-sensitive, and market\-driven approaches into food security and agriculture programming.
* Ensure program modalities are context\-appropriate, conflict\-sensitive, and responsive to beneficiary needs.
* Ensure that all CTP program activities are implemented, to a high technical quality, in accordance with the IRC CTP Implementation Procedure, and according to established minimum standards and/or quality benchmarks.
* Promote gender\-, youth\-, and protection\-responsive economic empowerment in line with IRC’s EA$E model.
* Support emergency preparedness and rapid response scale\-up when required.
* Collaborate with the ERD Snr Coordinator to shape strategic direction and expansion opportunities.
* Lead market systems and value chain assessments to identify economic recovery opportunities.
* Strengthening linkages with private sector actors, financial institutions, and local authorities.
* Promote inclusive financial services (savings, credit, digital finance) to enhance household and SME resilience.
* Support climate\-smart agriculture and sustainable local food production systems.
* Facilitate job creation and entrepreneurship opportunities targeting women and youth.
* Strengthen adaptive capacities and shock\-responsive mechanisms for vulnerable households.

 **2\.** **Grant Planning, Implementation \& Business Development**

* Develop and maintain detailed workplans aligned with grant timelines and strategic objectives.
* Provide direction and monitor staff in their implementation of the workplan and quality of technical activities, share relevant information and direction to improve quality and achieve timelines.
* Oversee budget utilization, procurement planning, and spending forecasts.
* Assist in managing program transitions, budget oversight, and procurement/spending plans.
* Ensure timely and high\-quality donor reporting (monthly, quarterly, annually).
* Monitor implementation progress against indicators and ensure quality benchmarks are met.
* Contribute to proposal development, concept notes, and technical design for recovery and resilience programming.
* Identify opportunities to expand ERD programming in stable states and diversify funding toward economic stability initiatives.

 **3\.** **Staff Management and Development**

* Directly support and functionally supervise CTP Officers and other staff engaged in cash transfer programming.
* Build team capacity in: Cash and market\-based programming; Livelihood recovery models; EA$E (VSLA, entrepreneurship, financial literacy); Market systems approach and conduct regular performance reviews and provide structured coaching.
* Foster a professional, respectful work environment, promoting teamwork and guiding staff to perform effectively.
* Maintain open and professional relations with team members, promote a strong team spirit and provide oversight and guidance to enable staff to successfully perform in their positions.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, including quarterly discussions and annual evaluations.
* Promote staff well\-being, model healthy work\-life balance, and respond to staff care needs appropriately.
* Supervise ERD Officers and field teams, ensuring clarity of roles and performance standards.
* Foster a respectful, inclusive, and accountable team environment.
* Promote staff well\-being and duty of care principles.

 **4\.** **Grant Monitoring and Reporting**

* Undertake regular field monitoring visits to assess progress and identify technical quality issues and/or other implementation issues, provide solutions and implement modifications as required.
* Ensure staff are adequately trained and undertaking effective data collection through post distribution monitoring, vendor monitoring tools, feedback mechanisms and other necessary data collection systems,
* Ensure all monitoring activities are fully documented, including systematic and timely data collection as required under the grant and for IRC M\&E purposes.
* Produce/contribute to IRC and donor reports as per set schedules (monthly, quarterly, and annually) on grant activities, indicators and achievements.
* Conduct regular field monitoring to ensure technical quality and compliance.
* Ensure strong Post\-Distribution Monitoring (PDM), market monitoring, and vendor monitoring systems.
* Support measurement of outcome\-level indicators such as: Income restoration; Business sustainability; Financial inclusion access; Household resilience
* Ensure community feedback and complaints mechanisms are functional and responsive.
* Promote adaptive management through real\-time data use and learning.

 **5\.** **Partner Identification and Management**

* Monitor partner performance to ensure project objectives are met; provide technical support and guidance.
* Provide technical oversight and capacity strengthening to partners.
* Identify and engage new partners, including private sector actors, to support ERD activities.
* Support the ERD Snr Coordinator in external representation and technical coordination with INGOs, CBOs, clusters, and working groups, where relevant.
* Identify and manage partnerships with local NGOs, CBOs, and private sector actors.
* Represent IRC in Cash Working Group, Livelihoods/Food Security Cluster, and coordination platforms.
* Strengthen collaboration with consortium partners and local authorities to ensure complementarity and avoid duplication.

 **Internal and External Contacts**

* **Internal:** Coordination with IRC Sudan’s program teams (Protection, Health, EH), Grants, Supply Chain, HR, and Finance.

* **External**: Engagement with humanitarian actors, local partners, UN agencies, government entities, and service providers.

 **Professional Standards**

* All IRC staff must adhere to The IRC Way—Standards for Professional Conduct, including policies on safeguarding, fiscal integrity, and anti\-harassment.
* IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers candidates based on merit regardless of background or identity.

 **Travel and Location Requirements**

* Based in Khartoum/Omdurman under RN and KHA field offices, with frequent travel to Al Jazira, Blue Nile, and other field sites.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in social sciences, economics, international affairs, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 3 years of humanitarian experience, ideally with cash transfer, economic recovery, or market\-based programming.
* Strong leadership, program and budget management, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to work in diverse, high\-pressure environments and lead multi\-disciplinary teams.

 **PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS**


All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way \- Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

* Objective Setting of the entire team are SMART \& in line with AOP, business \& people priorities.
* Midyear Review\- Ensure MYR is done between manager \& employee to provide directions on the progress
* Annual Appraisal\- Ensure PDRs are well written, onus for calibration of the region team and fitting the bell curve. Compilation of data to ensure high quality Calibration and pay for performance
* Focal Point Discussion\- Ensure this happens between manager, employee \& HR and employee is provided feedback with relevant data and developmental inputs.


 Management Connect Survey – Ensure participation by providing correct data and effective administration and follow\-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to share scores \& drive action planning.
   

  

 Org. Health survey – Ascertain employee participation by ensuring accuracy in data and effective administration and follow\-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to bring out insights, create \& drive action planning.
   

  

 People Planning process – Coach the team and build CDAPs for the region team. Support the RM in building people plan for the region team and ensure that the movements are in line with the people planning process. Implement the development action plan in line with employees CDAP.
   

  

 PMP Survey – Ensure participation of the region team and take corrective action as per employee feedback.
   

  

 Staffing
   

  

* Responsible for recruitment in the Region – Channel Wise (Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, Wholesale, Up Country) supporting region business plan in each of the channel up to L05 in the region. (Sales Trainee to Area Sales Manager)
* Own the staffing and recruitment process from end to end (manpower planning, sourcing, joining \-\-\> on Boarding) for upto L05 level. Support the induction for L6\+ population for the region.
* Internal Job Posting – Own up the IJP for the region (L01\- L05 level)
* Maintain employee number as per the AOP and track it on a monthly basis
* Ensure minimal man\-day loss on account of employee exit and replacement, quick turnaround.
* Bring in diversity of talent in the team by hiring diverse workforce from different facets.
* Ensure that the Exit interview is done and analysis of same is fed back to the relevant process/ system.


 Employee Engagement \& Culture Building
   

  

* Be an employee champion \- Reach out to the frontline to ensure good connect and resolve frontline issues in minimum time.
* Own the R\&R for the region – ROH as per plan, Area Manager of the month, Customer Executive of the month, family day, creating excitement by creating/rolling out appropriate regional contests (rollout of national contests as per BU plan)
* Partner with the RM to nominate the high performing sales employees for regional/national/international ROH
* Own up the engagement agenda for the region as per the agreed plan and ensure high employee involvement.
* Set up appropriate two way communication channel with the frontline.
* Ensure that all relevant HR processes are communicated to the frontline and build a strong PepsiCo Employer Proposition.
* Drive the organizational Values and Code of Conduct to the frontline through appropriate communication, highlighting deviation and being the role model themselves.


 Capability Building
   

  

 Drive organization capability agenda in partnership with RM \& BU HR \- Ensure employee development as per development needs highlighted thru Performance management process \& People planning. Follow 70:20:10 principle.
   

  

 Create Performance improvement plan with RM for the people in concern area.
   

  

 Implementation of change initiatives and supporting continuous improvement in sales function.
   

  

 Facilitate delivery of development and training activities for employees and monitor effectiveness for business results as per the requirement.
   

  

 Administration and MIS
   

  

* Generate, own and maintain various People Process reports/ records/ analysis and must Win Battles Report. Send the reports to HO as per timelines and as required and drive appropriate action plans in partnership with RM \& BUHR
* Ensure that relevant HR Admin support is provided to the employees in a timely manner
* Own up the Third Party Resources (TDO\- SPO, Admin resources): Process Ownership ( T\&E, Salary, Imprest, Grievance handling, complete control and processing)


**Skill/Attributes/Work Experience**
* Ability to anticipate, prioritize and Multitask
* Interpersonal relations – Collaboration and expectation management of the line
* Expert in productive communication – Be able to influence and impact without formal power
* Know the business – Good understanding of the sales levers
* Functional Excellence \- Good understanding of HR processes
* Process Orientation – Be able to maintain process integrity
* High Value Orientation with strong Drive and Execution orientation
* High Learning Agility \& high Customer Orientation

* **3D Modeling and 2D Drafting:** Create and modify detailed **3D models** and **2D engineering drawings** of machine components, sub\-assemblies, and complete machine layouts using CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor).
* **Component Selection:** Assist in the selection of standard mechanical components such as motors, gears, bearings, pneumatics, and fasteners, ensuring they meet design specifications and industry standards.
* **Design Documentation:** Maintain and update the engineering documentation library, including Bills of Materials (**BOMs**), assembly instructions, and technical specifications for manufacturing.

2\. Analysis and Optimization

* **Basic Calculations:** Perform fundamental engineering calculations (e.g., stress, strain, tolerance, material strength) to validate design integrity and functionality.
* **Tolerance Stacks:** Conduct **tolerance analysis** to ensure proper fit and function between mating parts, focusing on designs for manufacturability and assembly (**DFMA**).
* **Prototyping Assistance:** Support the engineering team during the prototyping and initial build phase, observing and reporting on machine performance and identifying areas for design improvement.

3\. Manufacturing and Quality Liaison

* **Supplier Interaction:** Work with procurement and external suppliers to review component specifications and ensure timely delivery of parts according to design requirements.
* **Shop Floor Support:** Act as a technical resource for the production and assembly teams, addressing design\-related queries and providing clarification on engineering drawings.
* **Quality Checks:** Participate in the inspection and testing of finished components and assemblies to confirm they adhere to the design specifications and quality standards.

4\. Continuous Improvement and Learning

* **Standards Compliance:** Learn and adhere to industry\-specific safety, hygiene, and performance standards relevant to food/beverage and pharmaceutical packaging equipment (e.g., **FDA, GMP**).
* **Problem\-Solving:** Assist senior engineers in investigating and resolving mechanical failures, performance issues, and root cause analysis during testing or field deployment.
* **Documentation:** Prepare technical reports, design review presentations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) as required.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

* **Bachelor's degree** in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from an accredited institution.
* **No prior full\-time industry experience required** (0\-1 year of experience is acceptable, including relevant internships or academic projects).

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in at least one major **3D CAD software** (e.g., **Onshape,** SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA).
* Strong understanding of **GD\&T** (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) principles.
* Solid knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals, including **statics, dynamics, material science**, and **machine design**.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as **CNC machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication**, and various surface treatments.

Soft Skills

* Excellent **written and verbal communication** skills.
* Strong **problem\-solving** and analytical abilities with a keen attention to detail.
* Ability to **work collaboratively** in a team environment and take direction from senior staff.
* Proactive attitude and a strong desire to learn and take ownership of tasks.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in the specialized field of automated machinery design. Do you want to explore the specific technical challenges unique to filling and packaging equipment, such as high\-speed mechanics or hygienic design?

description:
**Job Description**

**About Navpath**

Navpath Maritime Academy is a respected IMU CET coaching institute in Kottayam, training aspiring Merchant Navy officers. We are growing steadily, with new batches launching in July 2026, and are building a team that can match that pace.

**Job Role**

This is not a typical script\-reading telecaller role. We are looking for confident communicators who can take ownership of a lead from first call to confirmed admission. You will speak with parents and prospective students every day, build trust, answer real questions about a serious career choice, and convert genuine interest into enrollments.

You will also help us understand which leads are converting and which are not, so the team can adjust messaging and campaigns intelligently.

Morning Shift: 9 am \- 5 pm (Full Time)

Evening Shift: 5 pm \- 11 pm (Part Time)

**What You'll Do Day\-to\-Day**

* Call prospective students and parents from our daily lead list. Follow up consistently until they decide, one way or the other.
* Handle inbound calls and WhatsApp enquiries warmly and professionally.
* Counsel families on courses, fees, scholarship test, and the admission process. Handle objections calmly.
* Schedule and confirm campus visits, scholarship tests, and demo classes.
* Maintain a clean, up\-to\-date lead record — every call logged, every status updated, no lead going cold.
* Spot patterns in your conversations — which messages land, which objections repeat, which lead sources convert. Share these insights with the marketing team weekly.
* Support WhatsApp broadcasts and basic marketing activities when the team needs an extra pair of hands.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Fluent Malayalam and confident working English. You will speak to families across Kerala — clarity matters more than accent.
* Graduate preferred. Plus Two with a strong skill profile and proven communication ability also welcome.
* 1\-3 years in telecalling, sales, admissions counselling, EdTech, or BPO is preferred. Strong freshers who can demonstrate real communication skill are also encouraged to apply.
* Comfortable with target\-driven environments. Patient with parents, persuasive with students.
* Hands\-on with smartphone, WhatsApp, Excel or Google Sheets, and basic CRM tools.
* Honest, disciplined, ethical. We build relationships with families that last years — your conduct represents us.
* Willing to learn the maritime industry basics on the job, so you can speak credibly with serious aspirants.

**Skills That Will Help You Stand Out**

Candidates bringing any of these will be considered for broader responsibilities:

* Prior education or coaching institute experience
* Graphic design (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator)
* Social media handling (Instagram, Facebook, reels)
* Content writing in Malayalam or English
* Basic video editing (CapCut, InShot)
* Working knowledge of any CRM or lead management tool

**Shifts Available**

* Day Shift: 9 AM – 5 PM (8 hours)
* Evening Shift: 5 PM – 11 PM (6 hours)

*Pay structures differ between the two shifts to reflect the hours. Please clearly state your preferred shift in your application.*

**What We Offer**

* Pay as per industry standards, based on shift, experience, and skill set.
* A well\-equipped, professional office at our Kottayam campus.
* Structured onboarding and training on our courses, audience, and conversion approach.
* Real responsibility from week one. As we grow, strong performers grow with us.
* A respectful, ethical work culture. We treat families well, and we treat our team the same way.

**How to Apply**

Email your CV to hr@navpathacademy.com or WhatsApp it to \+91 9400587885\.

In your message, please include:

* Your current location (to confirm commuting feasibility)
* Preferred shift (Day or Evening)
* Any additional skills you bring (design, social media, video, content)
* A brief note (3\-4 lines) on why you think you'd be a good fit

*Walk\-in interviews welcome, Monday to Saturday, 10 AM – 4 PM, at our Kottayam campus. Please carry an updated CV and a recent photograph.*

The ideal candidate has deep, hands\-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls, Aruba ClearPass 802\.1X authentication, Cisco LAN, Meraki lan, wireless and ISP/vendor management in a complex, distributed environment.
   

  

 Network Design \& Operations

* Manage and optimize Cisco switching infrastructure (VLANs, trunking, STP, routing)

* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, VPNs, threat prevention, and URL filtering
* Implement and support 802\.1X network authentication using Aruba ClearPass, including wired and wireless NAC policies
* Collaborate with security teams to enforce network security standards and compliance requirements
* Monitor and remediate network vulnerabilities and security events


 Connectivity \& ISP Management
   

  

* Manage SD\-WAN solutions to ensure reliable and cost\-effective site connectivity
* Oversee ISP relationships, including circuit provisioning, troubleshooting, cellular connectivity and escalation management
* Support site\-to\-site VPNs and remote user VPN connectivity


 Monitoring, Maintenance \& Documentation

* Perform firmware upgrades, configuration audits, and network health checks
* Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures
* Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing for network services

* Strong expertise with Palo Alto firewalls, including threat prevention and URL filtering
* Proven experience implementing Aruba ClearPass for 802\.1X network authentication
* Deep knowledge of Cisco LAN switching and Meraki wireless environments
* Experience with SD\-WAN, WAN technologies, and ISP circuit management
* Solid understanding of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP preferred)
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting global or multi\-site enterprise networks
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds)
* Network or security certifications (CCNP, CISSP, PCNSE, Palo Alto, Aruba, etc.) a plus

title: Bending Machine Operator/CNC(Bending) Machine Operator
description:
**Job Description – CNC Bending Machine Operator**

**Position Title:** Bending Machine Operator / CNC (Bending) Machine Operator  
**Reporting To:** Production Manager  
**Base Location:** Vahelam  
**Leave Policy:** 15 Privilege Leaves \+ 8 Holidays per year  
**Salary:** As per industry standards

**Role Overview**

The CNC Bending Machine Operator will be responsible for operating press brake machines (TruBend 1100\) to bend stainless steel sheets and fabricated parts. The role requires technical expertise in interpreting drawings, selecting tooling, and ensuring precision in bending operations for kitchen equipment and sheet metal products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Machine Operation**: Operate CNC press brake machine (TruBend 1100\) for bending stainless steel sheets and fabricated parts.
* **Drawing Interpretation**: Read and interpret technical drawings, bending charts, and job orders.
* **Tool Selection**: Select appropriate punches, dies, and tooling for stainless steel materials.
* **Precision Bending**: Ensure accurate bending as per dimensions, angles, and tolerances.
* **Product Handling**: Work on stainless steel tables, sinks, cabinets, exhaust hoods, counters, and shelving.
* **Backgauge Usage**: Use backgauge system for precise positioning of sheet metal components.
* **Inspection**: Inspect finished parts using measuring tools (vernier, height gauge, angle gauge).
* **Surface Quality**: Maintain surface finish quality, avoiding scratches on stainless steel sheets.
* **Optimization**: Optimize bending sequence to reduce setup time and material wastage.
* **Troubleshooting**: Perform minor troubleshooting and machine adjustments when required.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Education:** ITI (Fitter) or equivalent qualification.
* **Experience:** 0–5 years (preferably in equipment, machine, or kitchen industry).
* **Eligibility:** Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
